insights.summary: Q2 FY27 revenue was ₹224 Cr (up 411% year on year, 43% on the quarter) with EBITDA of ₹172 Cr at a 76.6% margin and PAT of ₹73 Cr. The MD again declined to give guidance ('we don't give any guidance') and no capex or deployment plan was announced. The next lot of B200 GPUs is expected live this quarter, a slip from the July timeline, and a nearly ₹1,000 Cr contract now covers the first B200 cluster to June 2029.

what_changed.text: Second B200 lot now 'this quarter' (Q3), after being slated for Q2
Nearly ₹1,000 Cr multi-year sovereign-AI contract through June 2029
New Chief Revenue Officer, Field CTO and a strategic advisor
70%+ EBITDA margin business over the medium to long term

tone.label: steady
tone.quote: And this is still day zero of AI for us, as far as we can see.

analyst_questions.answer: 'We always say, look back at what we have done rather than giving a future guidance.'
Will not chase short-term hourly rates; some GPUs are kept for own platform R&D; uncontracted capacity expected to earn more.
No forward-looking predictions; plans will be announced once fructified. No upper limit on debt as long as cash flow repays it.
India AI Mission was 13-15% of Q2 revenue; international 20-25%; no contracted-revenue share given.

red_flags.text: Next B200 lot is a quarter late and no advance payment shows on the balance sheet, as an analyst noted.
No guidance, no capex plan and no disclosure of contracted versus short-term revenue, so quarterly revenue is hard to forecast.
Part of the GPU fleet is used internally rather than sold, which holds back rentable capacity.
A ₹1,500 Cr fundraise enabling resolution is in place; dilution timing unclear.

watch_next: Second B200 lot going live and billing in Q3
Revenue and the 76% margin holding with the full quarter of existing GPUs
Any capex and deployment announcement or equity raise
India AI Mission renewals and share of revenue

business_snapshot.what_they_make: GPU cloud and AI platform (TIR, Jarvis) running on NVIDIA H100, H200 and B200 clusters
business_snapshot.customers: Indian AI start-ups and enterprises, India AI Mission beneficiaries (13-15%), international customers (20-25%), a sovereign-AI company
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Not split by training, inference or storage; management declined to break it down
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Sovereign AI, India AI Mission, GPU price increases, move from training to inference and agents
